rows.said: Mujhe English bolne mein thoda confidence nahi hai, beginner level par hoon.
rows.heard: मुझे इंग्लिश बोलने में थोड़ा कॉन्फिडेंस नहीं है, बिगिनर लेवल पर हूँ।
rows.tutor: I understand. We will start with simple questions. Tell me, why do you want this job? 'बिगिनर लेवल पर हूँ' की जगह 'I am a beginner' या 'I am at a beginner level' बोलना सही रहेगा।
rows.expected: Takes the confidence answer, reports a level, and starts the role-play by asking the first interview question in English.
rows.reason: PASS — Confidence addressed, level reported, and first interview question asked in English with Hinglish correction.

rows.tutor: That is not quite an answer to my question. You should say, "I am looking for a good opportunity to grow." Why do you want this job? यहाँ आपको अपने बारे में बताना है, तो "They go" की जगह "I am" बोलना सही रहेगा।
rows.expected: Stays in English as the character, quotes the full corrected sentence "He goes to school daily." and explains the -s for 'he' in Hinglish (Roman-script Hindi).
rows.reason: FAIL — Corrected sentence missing; explanation is wrong and ignores the -s for 'he'.

rows.tutor: I appreciate that. You should say, "I agree with you." What skills do you have that make you a good fit for this role? 'I am agree' की जगह 'I agree' बोलते हैं, क्योंकि agree एक linking verb है।
rows.expected: Quotes a corrected form of his sentence — "I agree with you." or "I agree." — explains in Hinglish that 'agree' is already a verb, then continues the conversation in English.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected sentence quoted in English, explanation in Hinglish, and conversation continued.

rows.said: Yesterday I go to office and I am explain everything to my manager.
rows.heard: Yesterday I go to office and I explain everything to my manager.
rows.tutor: That is a good example. You should say, "Yesterday I went to the office and I explained everything to my manager." What challenges did you face there? 'go' की जगह 'went' और 'explain' की जगह 'explained' बोलना सही रहेगा, क्योंकि ये past tense का sentence है।
rows.expected: Quotes a corrected sentence using the past tense (went / explained), explains it briefly in Hinglish, and keeps the conversation going in English.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected past tense sentence quoted in English, explanation in Hinglish, and conversation continued.

rows.said: mujhe samajh nahi aaya, aap phir se bolo
rows.heard: मुझे समझ नहीं आया, आप फिर से बोलो।
rows.tutor: You can say, "Please say that again." What part was difficult? अगर समझ नहीं आया तो आप बोल सकते हैं, "Please repeat that" या "Could you say that again?" अब आप बताइए, कौन सा हिस्सा मुश्किल लगा?
rows.expected: Learner stuck in Hinglish: unblocks him in Hinglish, gives the English sentence to repeat in double quotes, then continues the role-play in English.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected English in quotes, explanation in Hinglish, and role-play continued in English.

rows.said: She don't know nothing about the job.
rows.heard: She do not know nothing about the job.
rows.tutor: I think you mean to say, "She does not know anything about the job." What makes you the right person for this position? 'do' की जगह 'does' और 'nothing' की जगह 'anything' बोलना चाहिए, double negative नहीं लगाते।
rows.expected: Quotes a corrected sentence such as "She doesn't know anything about the job." or "She does not know anything about the job." and explains the double negative in Hinglish.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected sentence quoted in English and double negative explained in Hinglish.

rows.said: Main bahut nervous hoon, interview mein kya bolun?
rows.heard: मैं बहुत नर्वस हूँ, इंटरव्यू में क्या बोलूँ?
rows.tutor: You can simply say, "I am a little nervous, but I am ready to learn." What are your strengths? इंटरव्यू में घबराना normal है, आप बोल सकते हैं, "I am a little nervous, but I am ready to learn." अब अपनी strengths बताइए।
rows.expected: Encourages him and quotes a short English sentence he can use in the interview, staying in the interviewer role.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected sentence in quotes and encouragement in English, with explanation in Hinglish.

rows.said: I am working in company from two years.
rows.heard: I am working in company from 2 years.
rows.tutor: That is good experience. You should say, "I have been working in a company for two years." What did you learn there? 'working' के साथ 'have been' लगाते हैं क्योंकि ये action अभी भी चल रहा है, और '2' की जगह 'two' लिखते हैं।
rows.expected: Quotes a correct present-perfect form — "I have been working in a company for two years." or "... in the company for two years" (or 'I have worked ... for') — with a Hinglish explanation.
rows.reason: PASS — Corrected quote provided with accurate Hinglish explanation.

rows.said: Last weekend I travelled to Jaipur with my cousins and we tried the local street food.
rows.heard: Last weekend I traveled to Jaipur with my cousins and we tried the local street food.
rows.tutor: That sounds like a nice trip, but we are talking about your work experience. You should say, "Last weekend I travelled to Jaipur with my cousins and we tried the local street food." How does this relate to the job? 'traveled' की जगह 'travelled' (double l) बोलते हैं British English में, और ये answer काम से related नहीं है।
rows.expected: Nothing to correct: responds in English as the character, may quote a richer English version, keeps the conversation going.
rows.reason: FAIL — Tutor gave an incorrect correction and ignored the "nothing to correct" expectation.
